hints.title: Per-Node Root Traversal
hints.text: Because the graph is unweighted, running breadth-first exploration from every node finds the shortest path to any cycle containing that node.

hints.title: Parent Distance Tracking
hints.text: For each search root, maintain distance from root and the parent of each visited node in the search tree.

hints.title: Cross-Edge Cycle Detection
hints.text: When encountering an already-visited neighbor v that differs from parent[u], a cycle of length dist[u] + dist[v] + 1 is detected.

hints.title: Multi-Source BFS Cycle Detection Implementation

complexity.notes: BFS from each vertex runs in O(V + E) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: DFS-based cycle detection may find long cycles instead of the minimum cycle length.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(V + E) adjacency list and distance/parent arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Performs unweighted BFS from every vertex to find cross-edges of minimal depth sum.
